brief: creami uno slide deck per unicef in partnership con vodafone
Deck about school connectivity in Kenya
A 5-slide deck introducing Giga to a new donor
Dieci slide sul programma Giga in Brasile: obiettivi, numeri, partner Ericsson e Vodafone, prossimi passi

One slide per country: Kenya, Rwanda, Nigeria, Ghana. Each with what the ministry asked for, the status of the school mapping and the next step. Kenya: ministry wants a national dashboard, mapping done, next is telemetry. Rwanda: ministry wants offline access, mapping 80%, next is data validation. Nigeria: ministry wants state-level views, mapping 40%, next is more data sources. Ghana: ministry wants a public map, mapping done, next is launch.
Roadmap 2027 for the Connectivity Map: Q1 pilot in 3 countries, Q2 expand to 10 countries, Q3 public API launch, Q4 annual report. 6 slides.
Results deck for the board: 2.1M schools mapped, 146 countries, 34% of mapped schools connected, 1.2M students reached in 2026, $18M mobilised. Make it data-driven.
Short deck on why connectivity matters for learning. Include this quote from the Minister of Education of Rwanda, Joseph Nsengimana: Every connected school is a door that stays open after the bell.
A 12-slide deck with chapters: context, our approach, results so far, next steps. Topic: bringing internet to rural schools in Zambia.
Crea una presentación de 6 diapositivas sobre conectividad escolar en Colombia

Compare open data (healthsites.io) with verified government data for health facility mapping: strengths and weaknesses of each, then a recommendation. Two slides for each source, one for the recommendation.
Partnership deck for a telecom operator: why partner with UNICEF on school connectivity, what we offer, and the partnership tiers table

8 slides, one per region: Africa, Asia, Latin America, Europe, Middle East, Pacific. Same layout for all. Each region: number of countries active, main partner, main challenge. Africa: 22 countries, MTN, power. Asia: 9 countries, Ericsson, geography. Latin America: 11 countries, Millicom, funding. Europe: 4 countries, Vodafone, regulation. Middle East: 6 countries, Zain, security. Pacific: 5 countries, Digicel, distance.
Budget split for the 2027 programme: 40% infrastructure, 30% devices, 20% teacher training, 10% monitoring and evaluation. Show it as a chart, then one slide on each item.
Explain the 4-step process to onboard a school onto the Connectivity Map: register the school, verify its location, connect it, monitor the connection. Short deck.
20 slides on the product strategy for the Connectivity Map in 2027: vision, users, problems today, what we build, data, partnerships, risks, timeline, budget, asks.
